title: Group the terms
text: With $$u=\frac{x}{2}$$, the series is $$u+u^2-u^3+u^4+u^5-u^6$$ and so on, which equals $$\frac{u+u^2-u^3}{1-u^3}$$.

title: Simplify
text: Substitute $$u=\frac{x}{2}$$ to get $$\frac{\frac{x}{2}+\frac{x^2}{4}-\frac{x^3}{8}}{1-\frac{x^3}{8}}$$. Multiply the top and bottom by $$8$$ to get $$\frac{4x+2x^2-x^3}{8-x^3}$$.
